findings: keep

f1–8: it reads as a run. The legs alternate (f1 near leg planted, f5 far leg planted), the knees lift on the passing frames (f3, f7) and the push-off frames stretch out (f4, f8). The guide's timing came through.
keep
f1–8: faces the lower right in every frame and never flips.
keep

f1–8: minigun on the near (right) arm and pile-bunker on the far (left) arm, both attached at the shoulder and pointed forward and level. This is the first Tim-o set where the guns stay up while he runs.
keep
f1–8: pack fixed to the back with both cylinders upright. Transparent background, and no guide line, ellipse or cell border leaked into the art.
fault

f1–8 off-model: the torso is a plain sphere. The turnaround's sage chest plate, hip skirt and panel lines are missing, the lens is bigger and pale yellow, and the legs are slimmer than the turnaround's.
fault
f4, f8: the body rises far more than the guide's small bob. The top of the pack moves 83 px across the sheet and the height spreads 14%, so the loop will look bouncy.
note
Ground drift: the frames sit up to 41 px off the guide's ground line in their cells. The line-up step fixes it (the player shows both: turn Lined up off to see the raw placement).
note
f1, f5: a stray ink dot past the pile-bunker tip. Clean it in the atlas.
